creators.name: Ramen Adventures (Brian MacDuckston)
creators.scale: Tokyo-based ramen writer since 2008; author of 'Ramen at Home'; ~100k+ YouTube; publishes annual best-ramen lists

creators.credible: Named in the Japan brief as a vetted creator; each listing is a first-hand review of the specific shop. ONE corroborating source, never institutional.
